answer: Work waits on the grove until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the horizon of the next round. Reaching the walnut of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on redundant verification across independent nodes. Written in a bullet-like short clauses, then a summary line register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
